items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 94:1
items.html: It is known that there is an inverse relation between the vessels and the lights, for with the vessels, the order is that the upper ones come to the Partzuf first. The opposite is true with the lights, where the lower ones come first. Hence, when only the vessels of the Ketarim remain in it, only the light of Nefesh can necessarily be clothed there. (680, item 89)
